# Step - to_lower

`to_lower` · `toLower` · category: [Strings and type conversion](../../traversal/step_reference.md#strings-and-type-conversion)

Converts each string to lower case.

## Forms

```text
to_lower()
to_lower(arg1: Scope)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject("ABC").to_lower().next()   // abc
```
